<!DOCTYPE html>
<!--
================================================================================
  FILE:   Core Dashboard Template
  PATH:   Template/Core_Dashboard_Template.htm
  --------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  Canonical starting point for a new Fishbowl BI report AND the living
  style guide for the shared component library. Demonstrates every
  standard pattern (sticky header + action buttons, fb-drawer drawers for
  Filters/Settings/Help, multi-select filter widgets, FBLib.Table-driven
  data table with sort/filter/reorder/resize/lazy-render, FBLib.Settings
  persistence with admin Publish/Lock, debug drawer, icon-chip KPI tiles)
  plus a 🎨 STYLE GUIDE drawer that renders the whole fb-styles component
  catalogue live — buttons, pills, badges, KPI tiles, both table tiers,
  filter chips — from shared classes only. Copy to a new report path and
  adapt the title, settings key, SQL, and column definitions (drop the
  Style Guide drawer if unwanted); drawer wiring, table behaviour, and
  settings plumbing are inherited from fb-lib + fb-styles.
================================================================================
-->
<!--
    Long-form usage notes (kept beneath the canonical header above so anyone
    copying the template still sees the implementation guidance):

    IMPORTANT — Fishbowl substitutes the fb-lib Script directive on EVERY
    occurrence of its placeholder anywhere in the report HTML, not just
    inside script tags. That means we must NEVER mention the placeholder
    text in comments, code blocks, JS strings, or anywhere else visible —
    Fishbowl would expand each mention into the entire fb-lib.js source,
    which silently corrupts inline script blocks (unterminated strings)
    and can even blank the whole page. The directive is included exactly
    ONCE in this file: inside the inline script tag near the top of head.

    This template demonstrates every pattern currently considered standard:

      • fb-lib integration via an inline script + the saved fb-lib script
      • Sticky 56px header with action buttons (filters / settings / help / refresh / CSV / print)
      • Drop-down drawers (the .fb-drawer family) for Filters, Settings, Help —
        mutual-exclusion + ESC-to-close + trigger-button .active state are all
        handled by FBLib.Common.registerDrawer
      • Multi-select dropdown filters via FBLib.Common.MultiSelect
      • FBLib.Table for a scroll-fill data table with:
          - click-to-sort headers (asc → desc → off)
          - per-column text or select filters (sticky filter row below the headers)
          - drag-to-reorder columns
          - drag-to-resize columns (handle on right edge of each header)
          - lazy chunked render (200 rows at a time, scroll-to-load)
          - autocomplete on text filters (<datalist>)
      • Settings persistence via FBLib.Settings (userKey/masterKey/defaults), with
        admin-only "Publish" + "Lock user editing" controls
      • Debug drawer via FBLib.Common.mountDebugDrawer — bottom-fixed, draggable
        resize handle, toggled by the Show Debug Console checkbox in Settings
      • Flex-fill layout — the data table grows to fill all remaining vertical
        space, and a CSS var `--debug-drawer-h` pushes the body up when the
        debug drawer is open so its last row is never hidden

    To make a new report:
      1. Copy this file to its destination folder (e.g. PurchaseOrder/MyReport.htm)
      2. Change the <title>, the report key in FBLib.Settings.init(), and the
         data-loading + column definitions in the LOAD + COLUMNS sections.
      3. Optionally remove any drawer / feature you don't need.

    Everything else (drawer wiring, table behaviour, settings plumbing) is
    automatic and inherited from fb-lib.
-->
<html lang="en">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
    <title>Report Title — Fishbowl BI</title>

    <!-- Inter font (matches the rest of the suite). -->
    <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@300;400;500;600;700;800;900&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">

    <!-- Moment.js — kept around because most reports do date arithmetic.
         Remove if your report doesn't touch dates. -->
    <script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/moment.js/2.29.4/moment.min.js"></script>

    <!-- Shared Fishbowl BI lib — inlined by Fishbowl from the saved "fb-lib"
         script. Source of truth: scripts/fb-lib.js. -->
    <script>
        {% Script fb-lib %}
    </script>

    <!-- Shared Fishbowl BI stylesheet — inlined by Fishbowl from the saved
         "fb-styles" Style. Source of truth: scripts/fb-styles.css. Provides
         design tokens, .hdr-btn family, fb-drawer chrome, .btn, modal-*,
         toasts, app-tooltip, scrollbar, spinner, and .hidden. MUST come
         BEFORE the inline block so per-template rules win the cascade on
         identical selectors. -->
    <style>
        {% Style fb-styles %}
    </style>

    <style>
        /* =====================================================
           BASE + LAYOUT
           ----
           Design tokens live in fb-styles and follow the Fishbowl Global
           Brand Guidelines (Media Kit ▸ Brand Guidelines PDF; component
           mockup: Other_NOT_FOR_PRODUCTION/FB_Brand_Mockup.htm — and the
           🎨 Style Guide drawer in THIS file renders the catalogue live).
           Style new work off the tokens, never hardcoded hexes:
             --fb-blue #2d9cdb (+ -accent/-hover/-pressed); --color-primary
               aliases it for legacy selectors; --link/--link-hover for
               interactive text (.row-link/.order-link)
             --c-primary/-secondary/-tertiary  text (#101010/#506872/#8FA1A7)
             --bg-1/-2/-3/-4 + --border/--border-strong  surfaces & borders
             --menu-bg/--menu-bg-2  dark navy chrome (#0B3140/#0E3646) for
               table heads + drawer bands
             --tint-blue/--tint-blue-2  selected/active states
             --fb-success/-warning/-negative/-neutral  semantics
             --acc-purple/-maroon/-orange/-yellow/-sage (+ -bg/-con pairs)
               brand accents for pills, badges, chart categories
             --font/--mono  type stacks (Inter / Space Mono fallbacks)
             --r-btn/-card/-modal/-pill + --sh1/2/3  geometry & shadows
           COMPONENTS shipped by fb-styles (§22–33) — use, don't re-write:
             .topbar/.tabs + .ps-btn  (dashboard chrome — 60px)  OR
             header + .hdr-btn        (report chrome — 56px, used here)
             .filterbar/.fchip/.fdrop dashboard filter strip
             .spill                   status pills (one tone language)
             .kpi-tile/.kpi-chip      icon-chip KPI cards (+ .kpis grid)
             .rpt-table               compact REPORT table tier
             .tbl-wrap                roomier DASHBOARD table tier
             .row-link/.order-link    record links
             .ms-*                    multi-select skin (FBLib.Common.MultiSelect)
             .badge .b10–.b90         numeric status-code badges
             .close-x, .loading-overlay
           EXCEPTION: JS-built popup windows (print) and the pre-fb-styles
           bail-early banner must use literal hexes — no :root tokens exist
           in those contexts. The * box-sizing reset also lives in fb-styles;
           the template keeps only the extra body-level layout it needs.
           ===================================================== */
        * { box-sizing: border-box; }
        html, body { margin: 0; padding: 0; height: 100%; }
        body {
            font-family: 'Inter', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif;
            font-size: 13px; color: var(--c-primary); background: var(--bg-1);
            /* Body is a flex column: header (pinned 56px) + drawers + .app-shell
               (which itself flexes to absorb leftover height for the data table). */
            display: flex; flex-direction: column; min-height: 100vh;
            /* Reserved bottom strip = current debug-drawer height. Set by JS
               (see _observeDebugDrawer) so the always-fixed debug drawer never
               covers the last row of the data table. */
            padding-bottom: var(--debug-drawer-h, 0px);
            transition: padding-bottom 0.12s ease;
        }

        /* =====================================================
           HEADER  (56px sticky bar — title + action buttons)
           ----
           `header` (the 56px sticky bar) and the .hdr-btn family — including
           .hdr-btn-icon and the .active state — live in fb-styles. Only the
           per-element overrides specific to this template stay here.
           ===================================================== */
        header h1 { font-size: 16px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--c-primary); margin: 0; line-height: 1.15; }
        #statusLine { font-size: 12px; color: var(--c-tertiary); line-height: 1.15; margin: 2px 0 0; }
        .hdr-actions { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; }

        /* =====================================================
           DROP-DOWN DRAWERS  (.fb-drawer family — provided by fb-styles)
           ----
           The .fb-drawer / .fb-drawer-head / .fb-drawer-body / .fb-drawer-foot
           / .fb-drawer-close chrome lives in fb-styles. See the fb-lib block
           in scripts/fb-lib.js (search "DROP-DOWN DRAWER") for the wiring
           pattern. Only template-specific grid + form layout remains here.
           ===================================================== */
        /* Drawer body grid — lays config/filter groups out side-by-side
           with wrap-on-narrow. Default (flex) suits a few wide groups (e.g. a
           Help drawer). For a Settings panel with several SHORT groups, add the
           `fb-grid-cols` modifier (see below) so fields don't stretch wide. */
        .fb-grid { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 14px 22px; align-items: flex-start; }
        .fb-group { flex: 1 1 220px; min-width: 220px; }

        /* Multi-column variant — use class="fb-grid fb-grid-cols" on a drawer
           grid holding several short config groups. Packs them into as many
           ~210px columns as fit (≥4 on a wide drawer) and constrains the fields
           to column width, so selects/inputs never stretch to half the drawer.
           Collapses to 2 / 1 columns on narrow drawers. */
        .fb-grid-cols { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(210px, 1fr)); align-items: start; }
        .fb-grid-cols .fb-group { flex: none; min-width: 0; }
        .fb-grid-cols .fb-field select,
        .fb-grid-cols .fb-field input[type=text],
        .fb-grid-cols .fb-field input[type=date],
        .fb-grid-cols .fb-field input[type=password] { width: 100%; }
        @media (max-width: 520px) { .fb-grid-cols { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } }

        /* The backdrop scrim behind an open drawer is provided + managed by
           fb-lib: registerDrawer() injects a shared #fbDrawerScrim, greys the
           page on open, and closes the drawer on scrim-click / ESC. Do NOT add
           a local scrim, and do NOT override `.fb-drawer.open { z-index }`.
           fb-styles layers the drawer at z-index 10001 and fb-lib's scrim at
           10000, so the drawer sits ABOVE the scrim; lowering the drawer's
           z-index (an old pattern) drops it BEHIND the scrim — the whole page
           greys out and the drawer becomes unclickable. */
        .fb-group-title {
            font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 0.04em; color: var(--c-secondary); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
            padding-bottom: 4px; margin-bottom: 8px;
        }
        .fb-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; margin-bottom: 8px; }
        .fb-field label { font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--c-secondary); }
        .fb-field select, .fb-field input[type=text], .fb-field input[type=date] {
            padding: 4px 8px; font-size: 12px; border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: 6px; background: var(--bg-1); font-family: inherit; color: #415157;
        }
        .fb-field input[type=date] { background: #fff; }

        /* Settings/Help footer buttons. */
        .ds-btn { padding: 7px 13px; font-size: 12px; border-radius: 7px; border: 1px solid var(--border-strong); background: #fff; cursor: pointer; font-family: inherit; font-weight: 600; color: #415157; }
        .ds-btn:hover { background: var(--bg-2); }
        .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--color-primary); color: #fff; border-color: var(--color-primary); }
        .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--color-primary-dark); }
        .ds-btn-admin { background: var(--acc-orange-bg); border-color: var(--acc-orange); color: var(--acc-orange-con); margin-right: 6px; }
        .ds-lock-badge { background: var(--acc-orange-bg); color: var(--acc-orange-con); border: 1px solid var(--acc-orange); padding: 7px 10px; border-radius: 7px; font-size: 12px; margin-bottom: 14px; }

        /* =====================================================
           MULTI-SELECT DROPDOWN  (FBLib.Common.MultiSelect)
           ----
           The full .ms-* skin now ships in fb-styles (§32) — this
           template needs NO local multi-select CSS. The canonical
           markup contract lives in fb-lib's MULTI-SELECT doc block.
           ===================================================== */

        /* =====================================================
           APP SHELL  (flex-fills the area under the header/drawers)
           ----
           No horizontal padding: the table goes edge-to-edge for max
           usable column width, matching PurchaseOrderSummary's layout.
           The KPI strip below has its own thin padding so it doesn't
           collide with the viewport edges, but the table itself is
           perfectly flush.
           ===================================================== */
        .app-shell {
            width: 100%; max-width: none; margin: 0; padding: 0;
            flex: 1 1 auto; display: flex; flex-direction: column; min-height: 0;
        }

        /* KPI strip — icon-chip .kpi-tile cards (fb-styles §28) in a thin
           bar above the table. The tiles/chips/tones are all shared CSS;
           only this row's layout is local. For a full dashboard use the
           .kpis responsive grid instead of this inline row. */
        .kpi-row {
            display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 10px; align-items: stretch;
            padding: 10px 12px; background: var(--bg-1);
            border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); flex-shrink: 0;
        }
        .kpi-row .kpi-tile { min-height: 60px; padding: 8px 14px; min-width: 190px; }
        .kpi-row .kpi-chip { width: 34px; height: 34px; border-radius: 8px; }
        .kpi-row .kpi-chip svg { width: 17px; height: 17px; }
        .kpi-row .kpi-val { font-size: 20px; }

        /* =====================================================
           DATA TABLE  (FBLib.Table picks up .fb-table inside .fb-table-container)
           ----
           The container directly fills .app-shell's remaining height —
           no card wrapper, no border, no margins. The table is flush to
           the viewport edges so all available horizontal space is given
           to the data. Mirrors PurchaseOrderSummary's #tableWrap layout.
           ===================================================== */
        .fb-table-container { flex: 1 1 auto; min-height: 0; overflow: auto; background: #fff; }
        /* Canonical .fb-table CSS — these are the styles FBLib.Table.init()
           expects on its <table>. They mirror PurchaseOrderSummary's table. */
        table.fb-table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; font-size: 12px; table-layout: fixed; }
        table.fb-table th {
            background: var(--menu-bg); color: #fff; font-weight: 500;
            padding: 7px 10px; text-align: left; white-space: nowrap;
            cursor: grab; user-select: none; position: sticky; top: 0; z-index: 10;
        }
        table.fb-table th:active { cursor: grabbing; }
        table.fb-table th:hover { background: #164A5F; }
        table.fb-table th.sort-asc::after  { content: ' \2191'; opacity: 0.8; }
        table.fb-table th.sort-desc::after { content: ' \2193'; opacity: 0.8; }
        table.fb-table th.col-drag-over { background: #164A5F; border-left: 3px solid #CBE5FB; }
        table.fb-table tr.filter-row th {
            top: 34px; z-index: 9; background: var(--tint-blue); cursor: default;
            padding: 4px 6px; border-bottom: 2px solid var(--tint-blue-2);
        }
        table.fb-table tr.filter-row input, table.fb-table tr.filter-row select {
            width: 100%; padding: 3px 6px; font-size: 11px;
            border: 1px solid var(--border-strong); border-radius: 4px; background: #fff; color: var(--c-primary);
            font-family: inherit;
        }
        table.fb-table td { padding: 4px 10px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); white-space: nowrap; vertical-align: middle; }
        table.fb-table tr:nth-child(even) td { background: var(--bg-1); }
        table.fb-table tr:hover td { background: var(--tint-blue) !important; }
        table.fb-table .num-cell { text-align: right; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
        .fb-row-link { color: var(--fb-blue); cursor: pointer; text-decoration: none; font-weight: 600; }
        .fb-row-link:hover { text-decoration: underline; color: var(--fb-blue-accent); }
        .fb-col-resize {
            position: absolute; right: 0; top: 0; width: 6px; height: 100%;
            cursor: col-resize; user-select: none;
        }
        .fb-col-resize:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.3); }

        /* Body-cell badges (e.g. status pills) — always pair a brand accent
           tint (--acc-*-bg) with its matching on-tint text (--acc-*-con or a
           semantic). Blue tints mark active/in-flight, sage marks done,
           orange marks attention, maroon marks closed/late. */
        .badge { display: inline-block; padding: 1px 7px; border-radius: 3px; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 500; }
        .b-issued    { background: var(--tint-blue); color: var(--link); }
        .b-progress  { background: var(--acc-orange-bg); color: var(--acc-orange-con); }
        .b-fulfilled { background: var(--acc-sage); color: var(--fb-success); }
        .b-closed    { background: var(--acc-maroon-bg); color: var(--acc-maroon-con); }

        /* Custom scrollbar. */
        .fb-drawer-body::-webkit-scrollbar,
        .fb-table-container::-webkit-scrollbar { width: 8px; height: 8px; }
        .fb-drawer-body::-webkit-scrollbar-track,
        .fb-table-container::-webkit-scrollbar-track { background: var(--bg-2); border-radius: 4px; }
        .fb-drawer-body::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb,
        .fb-table-container::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb { background: var(--border-strong); border-radius: 4px; }
        .fb-drawer-body::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover,
        .fb-table-container::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover { background: var(--c-tertiary); }

        /* .hidden lives in fb-styles.css. */

        /* Print. */
        @media print {
            html, body { overflow: visible; }
            @page { size: A4 landscape; margin: 0.5in; }
            header, .hdr-btn, .fb-drawer, .fblib-debug-drawer { display: none !important; }
            .fb-table-container { overflow: visible !important; }
            table.fb-table th { position: static !important; background: #ddd !important; color: #000 !important; }
        }
    </style>
</head>
<body>

<!-- The backdrop scrim behind an open drawer is injected + managed by fb-lib
     (registerDrawer). No local scrim element is needed. -->

<!-- ====================================================================
     HEADER
     ==================================================================== -->
<header>
    <div>
        <h1>Report Title</h1>
        <p id="statusLine">Loading…</p>
    </div>
    <div class="hdr-actions">
        <button id="filtersBtn" class="hdr-btn" type="button" onclick="FBLib.Common.toggleDrawer('filtersOverlay')" title="Show / hide filters">
            <svg fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M3 4a1 1 0 011-1h16a1 1 0 011 1v2.586a1 1 0 01-.293.707l-6.414 6.414a1 1 0 00-.293.707V17l-4 4v-6.586a1 1 0 00-.293-.707L3.293 7.293A1 1 0 013 6.586V4z"/></svg>
            Filters
        </button>
        <button id="refreshBtn" class="hdr-btn" type="button" onclick="loadDashboard()" title="Refresh data">
            <svg fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M4 4v5h.582m15.356 2A8.001 8.001 0 004.582 9m0 0H9m11 11v-5h-.581m0 0a8.003 8.003 0 01-15.357-2m15.357 2H15"/></svg>
            Refresh
        </button>
        <button id="exportBtn" class="hdr-btn" type="button" onclick="exportCsv()" title="Export visible rows to CSV">
            <svg fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M12 10v6m0 0l-3-3m3 3l3-3m2 8H7a2 2 0 01-2-2V5a2 2 0 012-2h5.586a1 1 0 01.707.293l5.414 5.414a1 1 0 01.293.707V19a2 2 0 01-2 2z"/></svg>
            CSV
        </button>
        <button id="printBtn" class="hdr-btn" type="button" onclick="printReport()" title="Print">
            <svg fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M17 17h2a2 2 0 002-2v-4a2 2 0 00-2-2H5a2 2 0 00-2 2v4a2 2 0 002 2h2m2 4h6a2 2 0 002-2v-4a2 2 0 00-2-2H9a2 2 0 00-2 2v4a2 2 0 002 2zm8-12V5a2 2 0 00-2-2H9a2 2 0 00-2 2v4h10z"/></svg>
            Print
        </button>
        <span style="width:1px; height:18px; background:var(--border); margin:0 4px;"></span>
        <button id="helpBtn" class="hdr-btn" type="button" onclick="FBLib.Common.toggleDrawer('helpOverlay')" title="How to use this report">
            <svg fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"/><path d="M9.09 9a3 3 0 015.83 1c0 2-3 3-3 3"/><line x1="12" y1="17" x2="12.01" y2="17"/></svg>
            Help
        </button>
        <button id="styleBtn" class="hdr-btn" type="button" onclick="FBLib.Common.toggleDrawer('styleOverlay')" title="Component style guide — every shared fb-styles pattern, live">
            <svg fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M4 16l4.586-4.586a2 2 0 012.828 0L16 16m-2-2l1.586-1.586a2 2 0 012.828 0L20 14m-6-6h.01M6 20h12a2 2 0 002-2V6a2 2 0 00-2-2H6a2 2 0 00-2 2v12a2 2 0 002 2z"/></svg>
            Style Guide
        </button>
        <button id="setBtn" class="hdr-btn hdr-btn-icon" type="button" onclick="FBLib.Common.toggleDrawer('setOverlay')" title="Settings">
            <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="currentColor" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M19.14 12.94c.04-.31.06-.62.06-.94 0-.32-.02-.63-.06-.94l2.03-1.58a.49.49 0 00.12-.61l-1.92-3.32a.488.488 0 00-.59-.22l-2.39.96a7.03 7.03 0 00-1.62-.94l-.36-2.54a.484.484 0 00-.48-.41h-3.84c-.24 0-.43.17-.47.41l-.36 2.54c-.59.24-1.13.56-1.62.94l-2.39-.96c-.22-.08-.47 0-.59.22L2.74 8.87c-.12.21-.08.47.12.61l2.03 1.58c-.04.31-.06.63-.06.94 0 .32.02.63.06.94l-2.03 1.58a.49.49 0 00-.12.61l1.92 3.32c.12.22.37.29.59.22l2.39-.96c.5.38 1.03.7 1.62.94l.36 2.54c.05.24.24.41.48.41h3.84c.24 0 .44-.17.47-.41l.36-2.54c.59-.24 1.13-.56 1.62-.94l2.39.96c.22.08.47 0 .59-.22l1.92-3.32c.12-.22.07-.47-.12-.61l-2.01-1.58zM12 15.6A3.6 3.6 0 018.4 12 3.6 3.6 0 0112 8.4a3.6 3.6 0 013.6 3.6 3.6 3.6 0 01-3.6 3.6z"/></svg>
        </button>
    </div>
</header>

<!-- ====================================================================
     FILTERS DROP-DOWN DRAWER
     ==================================================================== -->
<div id="filtersOverlay" class="fb-drawer">
    <div class="fb-drawer-head">
        <h2>🔍 Filters</h2>
        <button type="button" class="fb-drawer-close" onclick="FBLib.Common.closeDrawer('filtersOverlay')" aria-label="Close">×</button>
    </div>
    <div class="fb-drawer-body">
        <div class="fb-grid">

            <!-- WHEN: date-range picker.
                 Drives the `p.datecreated >= … AND p.datecreated <= …`
                 clause in buildSQL(). The "Created" column in the data
                 table reads from the same field, so changing this
                 narrows both the SQL filter AND the visible date
                 column at once — useful for confirming the filter
                 worked as expected. -->
            <div class="fb-group">
                <div class="fb-group-title">Created</div>
                <div class="fb-field">
                    <label for="dateRangeSel">Date range</label>
                    <select id="dateRangeSel" onchange="onDateRangeChange()">
                        <option value="anytime" selected>Any time</option>
                        <option value="thisQuarter">This Quarter</option>
                        <option value="lastQuarter">Last Quarter</option>
                        <option value="thisFY">This FY</option>
                        <option value="lastFY">Last FY</option>
                        <option value="thisCalYear">This Calendar Year</option>
                        <option value="lastCalYear">Last Calendar Year</option>
                        <option value="custom">Custom range…</option>
                    </select>
                </div>
                <div id="customDateInputs" class="fb-field hidden" style="flex-direction:row; gap:6px; align-items:center;">
                    <input type="date" id="startDate" onchange="loadDashboard()" style="flex:1;" />
                    <span style="color:var(--c-tertiary);">→</span>
                    <input type="date" id="endDate" onchange="loadDashboard()" style="flex:1;" />
                </div>

//  COLUMN DEFINITIONS  (passed to FBLib.Table.init)
//  ----
//  Each column:
//    key       — must match a property on the row objects (LOWERCASE, since
//                runQuery returns lowercased keys).
//    label     — header text
//    width     — initial width in px (drag-resize updates it; persisted via
//                settingsKey: 'tablePrefs')
//    align     — 'left' | 'right' | 'center'
//    filter    — 'text' (default) | 'select' | false
//    filterOptions — for select filters: array of { value, label } or 'auto'
//                    to populate from the visible data
//    format    — optional cell formatter: (rawValue, row) => string|Node
//    link      — optional Fishbowl module name to open on cell click
//    money / qty — flags so the sort comparator uses numeric ordering
//    sortable  — defaults to true; set false to disable sort on this column
//    vis       — defaults to true; set false to hide initially
// ============================================================================
var _columns = [
    { key: 'num',          label: 'Part #',      width: 140, link: 'Part', filter: 'text' },
    { key: 'description',  label: 'Description', width: 320, filter: 'text' },
    { key: 'typename',     label: 'Type',        width: 130, filter: 'select', filterOptions: 'auto',
      format: function (v) {
          var cls = ({ 'Inventory':'b-issued', 'Service':'b-progress', 'Non-Inventory':'b-closed', 'Internal Use':'b-fulfilled' })[v] || '';
          return '<span class="badge ' + cls + '">' + (v || '') + '</span>';
      }
    },
    { key: 'uomcode',      label: 'UOM',         width: 70,  align: 'center', filter: 'select', filterOptions: 'auto' },
    { key: 'upc',          label: 'UPC',         width: 130, filter: 'text' },
    { key: 'stdcost',      label: 'Std Cost',    width: 110, align: 'right', money: true,
      format: function (v) { return v != null ? FBLib.Common.formatMoney(parseFloat(v)) : ''; } },
    { key: 'abccode',      label: 'ABC',         width: 60,  align: 'center', filter: 'select', filterOptions: 'auto' },
    { key: 'activeflag',   label: 'Active',      width: 70,  align: 'center', filter: 'select',
      filterOptions: [{ value: '1', label: 'Yes' }, { value: '0', label: 'No' }],
      format: function (v) { return String(v) === '1' ? 'Yes' : 'No'; }
    },
    { key: 'datecreated',  label: 'Created',     width: 110, align: 'center',
      format: function (v) { return v ? FBLib.Common.formatDate(String(v)) : ''; } }
];

// ============================================================================
//  DATE-RANGE HELPERS  (moment.js)
//  ----
//  Adjust getFYDates() if your fiscal year is not July → June.
// ============================================================================
function getQuarterDates(offset) {
    offset = offset || 0;
    var now = moment();
    var qStartMonth = Math.floor(now.month() / 3) * 3 - (offset * 3);
    var start = moment([now.year(), qStartMonth, 1]);
    var end   = moment(start).add(2, 'months').endOf('month');
    return { start: start.format('YYYY-MM-DD'), end: end.format('YYYY-MM-DD') };
}
function getFYDates(offset) {
    offset = offset || 0;
    var now = moment();
    var fyYear = (now.month() >= 6 ? now.year() : now.year() - 1) - offset;
    return { start: fyYear + '-07-01', end: (fyYear + 1) + '-06-30' };
}
function getCalendarYearDates(offset) {
    offset = offset || 0;
    var y = moment().year() - offset;
    return { start: y + '-01-01', end: y + '-12-31' };
}
function getDateRange() {
    var sel = document.getElementById('dateRangeSel').value;
    if (sel === 'anytime') return { start: '', end: '' };
    if (sel === 'custom') {
        return { start: document.getElementById('startDate').value, end: document.getElementById('endDate').value };
    }
    switch (sel) {
        case 'thisQuarter': return getQuarterDates(0);
        case 'lastQuarter': return getQuarterDates(1);
        case 'thisFY':      return getFYDates(0);
        case 'lastFY':      return getFYDates(1);
        case 'thisCalYear': return getCalendarYearDates(0);
        case 'lastCalYear': return getCalendarYearDates(1);
        default:            return { start: '', end: '' };
    }
}

function onDateRangeChange() {
    var sel = document.getElementById('dateRangeSel').value;
    document.getElementById('customDateInputs').classList.toggle('hidden', sel !== 'custom');
    if (sel !== 'custom') loadDashboard();
}

// ============================================================================
//  FILTERS
// ============================================================================
function clearFilters() {
    document.getElementById('filterNum').value = '';
    document.getElementById('filterDesc').value = '';
    document.getElementById('filterActiveOnly').checked = true;
    document.getElementById('dateRangeSel').value = 'anytime';
    document.getElementById('customDateInputs').classList.add('hidden');
    if (_typeMs) _typeMs.setSelected([]);
    if (_uomMs)  _uomMs.setSelected([]);
    if (_table) _table.clearFilters();
    loadDashboard();
}

async function loadFilters() {
    // Populate the Part Type + UOM multi-selects from the live data. NOTE:
    // column keys come back lowercase from runQuery — that's a Fishbowl
    // quirk, not a bug. Use `r.name`, not `r.Name`.
    try {
        var types = await runQueryP('SELECT id, name FROM parttype ORDER BY id');
        _typeMs.setItems(types.map(function (r) { return { value: r.id, label: r.name }; }));
    } catch (e) { debugLog('loadFilters: parttype failed: ' + e.message, 'warn'); }

    try {
        var uoms = await runQueryP('SELECT id, code, name FROM uom WHERE activeflag = 1 ORDER BY code');
        _uomMs.setItems(uoms.map(function (r) {
            return { value: r.id, label: r.code + (r.name && r.name !== r.code ? ' — ' + r.name : '') };
        }));
    } catch (e) { debugLog('loadFilters: uom failed: ' + e.message, 'warn'); }
}

// ============================================================================
//  SQL BUILDER
//  ----
//  Build the SQL from the active filter state. esc() / escSQL() guard against
//  injection — never concatenate raw user input.
// ============================================================================
function escSQL(s) { return FBLib.Common.escSQL(s); }
function safeDate(s) { return /^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(s) ? s : ''; }

function buildSQL() {
    var range = getDateRange();
    var where = ['1=1'];

    if (range.start && range.end && safeDate(range.start) && safeDate(range.end)) {
        where.push("p.datecreated >= TIMESTAMP '" + safeDate(range.start) + " 00:00:00'");
        where.push("p.datecreated <= TIMESTAMP '" + safeDate(range.end)   + " 23:59:59'");
    }
    if (_typeMs) {
        var tsel = _typeMs.getSelected().map(Number).filter(function (n) { return !isNaN(n); });
        if (tsel.length) where.push('p.typeid IN (' + tsel.join(',') + ')');
    }
    if (_uomMs) {
        var usel = _uomMs.getSelected().map(Number).filter(function (n) { return !isNaN(n); });
        if (usel.length) where.push('p.uomid IN (' + usel.join(',') + ')');
    }
    var pnum = document.getElementById('filterNum').value.trim();
    if (pnum) where.push("p.num LIKE '%" + escSQL(pnum) + "%'");
    var pdesc = document.getElementById('filterDesc').value.trim();
    if (pdesc) where.push("p.description LIKE '%" + escSQL(pdesc) + "%'");
    if (document.getElementById('filterActiveOnly').checked) {
        where.push('p.activeflag = 1');
    }

    return [
        'SELECT p.num, p.description, p.upc, pt.name AS typename,',
        '       u.code AS uomcode, p.stdcost, p.abccode, p.activeflag,',
        '       p.datecreated',
        'FROM part p',
        'LEFT JOIN parttype pt ON p.typeid = pt.id',
        'LEFT JOIN uom u ON p.uomid = u.id',
        'WHERE ' + where.join(' AND '),
        'ORDER BY p.num',
        'LIMIT 5000'
    ].join('\n');
}

// ============================================================================
//  DASHBOARD LOAD
//  ----
//  `_loadToken` guards against stale fetches superseding a newer one — a
//  common bug when filters change while a slow query is still in flight.
// ============================================================================
async function loadDashboard() {
    var tok = ++_loadToken;
    debugLog('loadDashboard [' + tok + ']: start', 'info');
    document.getElementById('statusLine').textContent = 'Loading…';

    try {
        var sql = buildSQL();
        debugLog('SQL: ' + sql.replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim(), 'query');
        var rows = await runQueryP(sql);
        if (tok !== _loadToken) { debugLog('loadDashboard [' + tok + ']: superseded', 'warn'); return; }

        _dataset = rows;
        debugLog('Loaded ' + rows.length + ' rows', 'success');
        document.getElementById('statusLine').textContent =
            rows.length.toLocaleString() + ' record' + (rows.length === 1 ? '' : 's');

        if (_table) _table.render();
        _renderKpis();
    } catch (e) {
        debugLog('loadDashboard error: ' + e.message, 'error');
        document.getElementById('statusLine').textContent = 'Error — see debug console';
    }
}

function _renderKpis() {
    document.getElementById('kpiTotal').textContent = _dataset.length.toLocaleString();
    var visible = _table ? _table.getVisibleRows().length : _dataset.length;
    document.getElementById('kpiVisible').textContent = visible.toLocaleString();
}

// ============================================================================
//  PRINT  — clean HTML in a NEW window, then call print on that window.
//  ----
//  `window.print()` on the report itself is unreliable inside JxBrowser
//  (the embedded browser Fishbowl uses for BI reports). The canonical
//  workaround — used across the suite — is to build a self-contained
//  print-friendly HTML doc, open it via `window.open('', '_blank')`,
//  write the doc, and call `print()` on the new window. The new window
//  is a "real" browser document so its print pipeline works normally.
//
//  Prints only the currently-VISIBLE rows (post-filter, post-sort) using
//  the visible column order from FBLib.Table — so the printed page
//  matches what the user sees on screen.
// ============================================================================
function printReport() {
    if (!_table) return;
    var cols = _table.getColumns().filter(function (c) { return c.vis !== false; });
    var rows = _table.getVisibleRows();
    if (!rows.length) { debugLog('printReport: no rows', 'warn'); return; }

    function escHtml(s) {
        return String(s == null ? '' : s).replace(/[&<>"']/g, function (c) {
            return ({ '&':'&','<':'<','>':'>','"':'"',"'":''' })[c];
        });
    }
    // Re-use each column's format() if present, then strip any HTML it
    // produced (e.g. badge <span> wrappers in the screen renderer aren't
    // useful in print — we just want the visible text).
    function cellText(col, row) {
        var raw = row[col.key];
        var out = (typeof col.format === 'function') ? col.format(raw, row) : raw;
        if (out == null) return '';
        var s = String(out);
        // Strip tags + decode the basic entities our screen formatters emit.
        s = s.replace(/<[^>]+>/g, '');
        return s.replace(/&/g, '&').replace(/</g, '<').replace(/>/g, '>').replace(/"/g, '"').replace(/'/g, "'");
    }

    var title = document.title || 'Report';
    var hdr = cols.map(function (c) { return '<th>' + escHtml(c.label) + '</th>'; }).join('');
    var body = rows.map(function (r) {
        return '<tr>' + cols.map(function (c) {
            var t = escHtml(cellText(c, r));
            var cls = (c.align === 'right') ? ' class="nr"' : (c.align === 'center' ? ' class="nc"' : '');
            return '<td' + cls + '>' + t + '</td>';
        }).join('') + '</tr>';
    }).join('');

    var html =
        '<!DOCTYPE html><html><head><meta charset="UTF-8"/>' +
        '<title>' + escHtml(title) + '</title>' +
        '<style>' +
            'body{font-family:Arial,sans-serif;font-size:8pt;margin:.4in;color:#111}' +
            'h2{font-size:11pt;margin:0 0 4px;color:#0B3140}' +
            '.sub{font-size:7.5pt;color:#506872;margin:0 0 10px}' +
            'table{border-collapse:collapse;width:100%}' +
            'th{background:#0B3140;color:#fff;font-size:7pt;padding:4px 5px;text-align:left;' +
                '-webkit-print-color-adjust:exact;print-color-adjust:exact}' +
            'td{font-size:7.5pt;padding:3px 5px;border-bottom:1px solid #E3E3E3}' +
            'tr:nth-child(even) td{background:#F7F7F7;-webkit-print-color-adjust:exact;print-color-adjust:exact}' +
            '.nr{text-align:right}.nc{text-align:center}' +
            '@page{size:A4 landscape;margin:.4in}' +
        '</style></head><body>' +
        '<h2>' + escHtml(title) + '</h2>' +
        '<p class="sub">' + rows.length.toLocaleString() + ' row' + (rows.length === 1 ? '' : 's') +
            ' — printed ' + new Date().toLocaleDateString() + '</p>' +
        '<table><thead><tr>' + hdr + '</tr></thead><tbody>' + body + '</tbody></table>' +
        '</body></html>';

    var w = window.open('', '_blank');
    if (!w) { debugLog('printReport: popup blocked', 'warn'); return; }
    w.document.write(html);
    w.document.close();
    w.focus();
    w.print();
    debugLog('Printed ' + rows.length + ' rows', 'success');
}

// ============================================================================
//  EXPORT CSV  — emits only the currently-visible (filter-passed) rows.
// ============================================================================
function exportCsv() {
    if (!_table || !_dataset.length) { debugLog('exportCsv: no data', 'warn'); return; }
    var cols = _table.getColumns().filter(function (c) { return c.vis !== false; });
    var rows = _table.getVisibleRows();
    var header = cols.map(function (c) { return '"' + c.label.replace(/"/g, '""') + '"'; }).join(',');
    var body = rows.map(function (row) {
        return cols.map(function (c) {
            var v = row[c.key];
            if (v == null) v = '';
            v = String(v).replace(/"/g, '""');
            return '"' + v + '"';
        }).join(',');
    }).join('\r\n');
    var blob = new Blob([header + '\r\n' + body], { type: 'text/csv;charset=utf-8;' });
    var url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    var a = document.createElement('a');
    a.href = url;
    a.download = 'report_' + new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0] + '.csv';
    a.rel = 'noopener'; a.style.display = 'none';
    document.body.appendChild(a); a.click();
    // Defer cleanup: revoking the object URL / removing the anchor synchronously
    // can truncate or cancel the download in Chromium/JxBrowser before it has
    // finished reading the blob.
    setTimeout(function () { try { document.body.removeChild(a); } catch (_) {} try { URL.revokeObjectURL(url); } catch (_) {} }, 4000);
    debugLog('Exported ' + rows.length + ' rows', 'success');
}

// ============================================================================
//  SETTINGS
// ============================================================================
function _hydrateSettings() {
    document.getElementById('setShowDebug').checked       = !!_resolve('showDebug', false);
    document.getElementById('setRememberFilters').checked = !!_resolve('rememberFilters', true);
}

function onSettingsChange() {
    var showDebug = document.getElementById('setShowDebug').checked;
    var remember  = document.getElementById('setRememberFilters').checked;
    _setUserKey('showDebug', showDebug);
    _setUserKey('rememberFilters', remember);
    _applyDebugDrawer(showDebug);
}

function resetSettings() {
    if (!confirm('Reset your personal settings to defaults?')) return;
    try { FBLib.Settings.clearUser(); } catch (_) {}
    _hydrateSettings();
    _applyDebugDrawer(!!_resolve('showDebug', false));
}

function publishDefaults() {
    if (!FBLib.Settings.isAdmin()) return;
    if (!confirm('Publish current settings as the default for all users?')) return;
    try {
        FBLib.Settings.publishMaster({
            dateRange:       document.getElementById('dateRangeSel').value,
            rememberFilters: document.getElementById('setRememberFilters').checked
        });
        debugLog('Defaults published', 'success');
    } catch (e) { debugLog('publishDefaults: ' + e.message, 'error'); }
}

function toggleUserEditing() {
    if (!FBLib.Settings.isAdmin()) return;
    try {
        var allowed = FBLib.Settings.userEditingAllowed();
        FBLib.Settings.setLock(allowed);   // setLock(true) = lock; setLock(false) = unlock
        _refreshAdminUi();
    } catch (e) { debugLog('toggleUserEditing: ' + e.message, 'error'); }
}

function _refreshAdminUi() {
    var isAdmin = FBLib.Settings.isAdmin();
    document.getElementById('dsAdminSection').style.display = isAdmin ? 'block' : 'none';
    var allowed = FBLib.Settings.userEditingAllowed();
    var badge = document.getElementById('dsLockBadge');
    badge.style.display = (!allowed && !isAdmin) ? 'block' : 'none';
    var lockBtn = document.getElementById('dsLockBtn');
    if (lockBtn) lockBtn.textContent = allowed ? 'Lock user editing' : 'Unlock user editing';
}

// ============================================================================
//  DEBUG DRAWER
//  ----
//  fb-lib mounts the drawer on demand. We observe its visibility/height to
//  reserve bottom padding on <body> so the data table is never covered.
// ============================================================================
var _debugApi = null;
function _applyDebugDrawer(showIt) {
    if (!_debugApi) _debugApi = FBLib.Common.mountDebugDrawer();
    if (!_debugApi) return;
    if (showIt) { _debugApi.show(); _debugApi.expand(); }
    else _debugApi.hide();
    if (_debugApi.element) _observeDebugDrawer(_debugApi.element);
}

function _observeDebugDrawer(el) {
    if (!el || el._observed) return;
    el._observed = true;
    var apply = function () {
        var visible = el.classList.contains('is-visible');
        var open    = el.classList.contains('is-open');
        var h = (visible && open) ? Math.ceil(el.getBoundingClientRect().height) : (visible ? 40 : 0);
        document.body.style.setProperty('--debug-drawer-h', h + 'px');
    };
    apply();
    if (typeof ResizeObserver === 'function') {
        try { new ResizeObserver(apply).observe(el); } catch (_) {}
    }
    try { new MutationObserver(apply).observe(el, { attributes: true, attributeFilter: ['class'] }); } catch (_) {}
}

// ============================================================================
//  INIT
//  ----
//  Wrapped in try/catch so a single broken statement (e.g. a typo in a
//  containerId, an undeclared variable, an SQL field that doesn't exist
//  in this install) doesn't silently kill the whole page. The catch
//  surfaces the error in the header status line + the browser console
//  so the next debugging step is obvious.
// ============================================================================
window.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', async function () {
  try {
    // 1. Register the drop-down drawers with fb-lib for mutual-exclusion +
    //    ESC-to-close + trigger-button .active state + the shared backdrop
    //    scrim (fb-lib injects #fbDrawerScrim, greys the page behind the open
    //    drawer, and closes it on scrim-click). No local scrim wiring needed.
    FBLib.Common.registerDrawer({ id: 'filtersOverlay', triggerId: 'filtersBtn' });
    FBLib.Common.registerDrawer({ id: 'setOverlay',     triggerId: 'setBtn'     });
    FBLib.Common.registerDrawer({ id: 'helpOverlay',    triggerId: 'helpBtn'    });
    FBLib.Common.registerDrawer({ id: 'styleOverlay',   triggerId: 'styleBtn'   });

    // 2. Build the multi-select widgets. Each `containerId` must match the
    //    .ms-container's id in the filter-drawer markup above. If either
    //    container is missing or the id is wrong, MultiSelect.create throws
    //    and the rest of init() never runs (which presents as a blank
    //    page) — so keep these in sync with the markup.
    _typeMs = FBLib.Common.MultiSelect.create({
        containerId: 'typeMs',
        items: [],     // populated by loadFilters() once we have data
        placeholder: 'All part types',
        onChange: function () { loadDashboard(); }
    });
    _uomMs = FBLib.Common.MultiSelect.create({
        containerId: 'uomMs',
        items: [],
        placeholder: 'All UOMs',
        onChange: function () { loadDashboard(); }
    });

    // 3. Initialise the table. FBLib.Table picks up #reportTable + our column
    //    array; it handles sort, filter, drag-reorder, drag-resize, lazy
    //    render, and (because we passed `settingsKey`) it persists column
    //    order + widths + sort to FBLib.Settings.
    _table = FBLib.Table.init({
        tableEl: document.getElementById('reportTable'),
        columns: _columns,
        getRows: function () { return _dataset; },
        chunkSize: 200,
        settingsKey: 'tablePrefs',
        // onSort/onReorder/onResize hooks are available if the report needs
        // to react to user-driven layout changes — e.g. recomputing KPIs.
    });

    // 4. Restore settings + sync UI.
    _hydrateSettings();
    _applyDebugDrawer(!!_resolve('showDebug', false));
    _refreshAdminUi();

    var savedDate = _resolve('dateRange', 'thisFY');
    if (savedDate) document.getElementById('dateRangeSel').value = savedDate;

    // 5. Populate filter options + load the dashboard.
    await loadFilters();
    await loadDashboard();

    debugLog('Report initialised', 'success');
  } catch (e) {
    console.error('[Report init] failed:', e);
    var sl = document.getElementById('statusLine');
    if (sl) sl.textContent = 'Init failed — ' + (e && e.message ? e.message : 'see browser console');
    try { FBLib.Common.debugLog('Init failed: ' + (e && e.stack ? e.stack : e), 'error'); } catch (_) {}
  }
});

// Expose handlers used by inline onclick="…" attributes.
window.loadDashboard      = loadDashboard;
window.clearFilters       = clearFilters;
window.exportCsv          = exportCsv;
window.printReport        = printReport;
window.onDateRangeChange  = onDateRangeChange;
window.onSettingsChange   = onSettingsChange;
window.resetSettings      = resetSettings;
window.publishDefaults    = publishDefaults;
window.toggleUserEditing  = toggleUserEditing;
</script>
